cutoff_proposal.definition: Research cutoff C = independently verified official scheduled post minus 10 minutes, freeze at C; actual start must be after C. Proposed design, not user-approved execution.
capture_windows: first available approved prestart official card
prestart correction and roster update only before C
final immutable seal whose upper uncertainty bound <= C
cutoff_proposal.post_change: If official post changes before C, record source and version and conservative earlier cutoff; never extend cutoff to admit late evidence. If post/start timing cannot be authenticated, hold replay.

permissions.additional_inquiry_text: 今回まず1競走のみを対象とし、発走前に公式出馬表と必要な過去成績の版を固定し、結果を見ずに独自分析を検証したいと考えています。原本は許可された保管場所に限定し、SHA-256、取得時刻、独立時刻証明、公式公表・訂正履歴、馬固有ID・成績行との対応を保存する予定です。原本の外部送信・再配布を行わない場合と、外部AI／クラウドに処理を委託する場合を分け、許可される取得方法・範囲・保存期間・費用の有無・既存アーカイブの正規回収経路についてご教示ください。料金が必要な場合は案内のみを希望し、契約は別途判断します。
user_approval_required_before: any permission-required acquisition or archive recovery

raw: exact received bytes; preserve encoding, content type, source URI, edition and request metadata in access-restricted approved storage
hash received bytes SHA256; separate decoded UTF8 text hash with exact decoding/version; never substitute digest domains
capture start/end, source version, publication and update instants, seal time, independent signed timestamp or equivalent trusted receipt; store timezone and uncertainty bound
capture end <= seal; seal upper uncertainty <= predeclared cutoff; publication <= update <= capture start for selected historical result version
immutable content address; append-only manifest, no overwrite; correction and supersession chain, authoritative inventory at cutoff; later versions separate
record permission scope/version at capture, throughout retention and processing, and release if relevant; revocation causes hold and handling per rights terms
identity: issuer native horse ID + event + runner number + raw row pointer, compare official profile and row
target and history roster records independently versioned; no name-only match; transfer crosswalk native IDs, authority, validity and publication
class rule and individual eligibility separate from class literal; effective dates and official source for course shape; draw number distinct from horse number
peer row exact same event, opponent native ID and separate original result and later result; temporal sequence and all dependency roots
typed_fields: finish/status (dead heat, DNF, exclusion and cancellation distinct)
finish_clock and individual final600 with native unit and explicit measurement scope
official margin literal and derived clock difference with both source roots; never convert lengths to seconds without validated method
grouped passing order with source checkpoint semantics, no invented ordering within group
race leader laps with boundaries/units, no missing individual clock inferred
class/course/draw/weight/going only within confirmed scope and applicable version
custody.outcome_isolation: Separate target result after freeze into access-separated validation store only after research artifact sealed. No target result or market in analyzer intake. No current production writes.

individual_vs_group.observation_gate: Authenticate the narrow fact (source authority, raw digest, row identity, publication/version/time, rights, measurement definition, dependencies). Supply only that observation to research after explicit authorization. Missing unrelated measurements stay null; no automatic grade or complete item claim.
individual_vs_group.benchmark_gate: All 118 groups retain seven gates and 826 held flags; official comparable course/class/time/rights cohort and independent approval required. A narrow observed clock does not establish a reference clock or benchmark, or scoring permission.

retrospective.Tokyo: 18 capture metadata records, 26 unresolved card rows, 13 class conflicts. Prior inspection found no raw write path or recovered bytes. Only existing lawful immutable backup or provider archived edition with matching digest/version may resolve; do not reconstruct from present web page.
retrospective.Saga: 29 prior witness locators and 1 leader lap candidate; current card captured after post, excluded. Only lawful original prestart card could reopen; otherwise prospective alternative.
retrospective.stop_rule: No repeated cache-miss fetching or unauthorized storage exploration. If lawful raw bytes unavailable, record unresolved and prioritize prospective race. No new archival access attempted.

limits: No actual permission verified, no external inquiry sent, no new source capture, no timestamp service contracted.

Independent timestamp and authority verification are specification only; no infrastructure provisioned. Future adapter requires separate actual trusted verifier; synthetic contract does not prove real trust.
Candidate choice is a proposed policy, not an actual dated race or guarantee of source availability.
